summary: WordPress via Podman + native MariaDB + Caddy — lighter LXC alternative to the VM-based module.
description: Generic WordPress: Podman container (PHP-FPM) + native MariaDB + Caddy. Independent of Community/src/AndreasJe/wordpress (NixOS/VM, heavier, cluster:ha, Redis, Authentik OIDC hook) — this is the lighter LXC/Podman alternative for sites that don't need those.

fieldHelp.proxyDomain: Public domain this site will be reachable at (e.g. blog.example.com) — baked into WordPress's own config at install time
